simple.meaning: מוּשׁ (mûwsh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to withdraw (both literally and figuratively, whether intransitive or transitive).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 21 times across Exodus, Numbers, Joshua, Judges, Job, and 7 more, beginning at Exodus 13:22. Its contexts include family line, covenant, commandment, Torah, mountain.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מוּשׁ (H4185).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: מוּשׁ (mûwsh) / H4185 is traced through Exodus 13:22, Exodus 33:11, Numbers 14:44, Joshua 1:8 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.short: to withdraw (both literally and figuratively, whether intransitive or transitive)
definitions.usage: cease, depart, go back, remove, take away.
definitions.full: H4185. mush I. [ מִישׁ מוּשׁ, Bö ii. 512 f. ; but Thes Kö i. 511 think purely ו׳׳ע ] verb depart, remove (Arabic ( י ) is walk with elegant, proud, self-conceited gait ); — Qal Perfect וּמָשׁ consecutive Zech 14:4 ; וּמַשְׁתִּ֫י 3:9 ; מָ֫שׁוּ Num 14:44 ; Imperfect יָמוּשׁ Josh 1:8 ; Isa 54:10 , etc.; — depart , mostly of inanimate things ( = be removed ) followed by מִן Josh 1:8 ; Isa 59:21 ; Jer 31:36 ; without preposition Prov 17:13 Qr, Isa 22:25 ; 54:10 (twice in verse) (|| מוֺט ); followed by ה locative Zech 14:4 ; followed by מִן person Judg 6:18 ; of both Num 14:44 ; transitive remove , followed by accusative Zech 3:9 . Hiph`il Imperfect יָמִישׁ Exod 13:22 6 t., etc.; remove, take away , followed by מִן Micah 2:3 ; followed by לְ 2:4 (but ᵐ5 Sta ZAW vi. 1886, 122f. מֵשִׁיב אֵין for יָמִישׁ אֵיךְ ); depart , followed by מִן person Exod 33:11 ; figurative recede Job 23:12 ; of idol, leave its place , Isa 46:7 ; of other inanimate things, followed by מִן Exod 13:22 ; figurative Psa 55:12 ; Prov 17:13 Kt (Qr יָמוּשׁ ); without preposition, absolute, Nahum 3:1 , subject טֶרֶף ; of righteous under figure of tree, מֶּ֑רִי מֵעֲשׂוֺת יָמִישׁ לֹא Jer 17:8 , i.e. shall not cease.
definitions.rootNote: a primitive root (perhaps rather the same as 4184 through the idea of receding by contact );
